scene: The clock pops open, dispensing stamped transit tokens onto the pavilion balcony.
picture: A wide side-scrolling platform across the balcony. On the far left, a hand-cranked trolley rests on tracks. Left of centre, the player stands with cane and cap, brass tokens in hand. At the centre, a striped water taxi waits by steps. On the far right, an open monorail car waits at a railed stop.
shown: a hand-cranked trolley on narrow tracks at the far left
a small striped water taxi bobbing along the centre canal edge
a sleek yellow monorail car idling at the far right platform
